dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One prominent, high-contrast white band visible on the greater coverts, formed by thick white feather tips against a dark gray-blue background.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, thin pale boundaries along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast, bright white rectangular-to-oval patch located on the side of the neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Highly distinct, sharp linear boundary between the black crown and the greenish-gray mantle.
